neighbours.label: The token ' surrender' (giving up to an enemy) and the newspaper name ' Times' after a city (New York Times, LA Times), in a dense, weak layer-2 unit; not synonyms such as 'give up' or other newspaper names.
fire: After weeks without food, the rebels chose to surrender to the royal army.
The captain would not surrender his sword to the enemy officer.
Historians still argue about why the city decided to surrender so quickly.
The emperor's radio speech announced the surrender of the nation.
The besieged troops were ordered to surrender at dawn.
As reported by the Los Angeles Times, the fires spread overnight.
A reporter for the New York Times broke the story on Friday.
The study was first described in the LA Times last spring.
quiet: After weeks without food, the rebels chose to give in to the royal army.
The captain would not hand his sword to the enemy officer.
Historians still argue about why the city decided to yield so quickly.
The emperor's radio speech announced the end of the war.
The besieged troops were ordered to retreat at dawn.
As reported by the Chicago Tribune, the fires spread overnight.
A reporter for the Boston Globe broke the story on Friday.
The study was first described in a local paper last spring.
